description.zh: 自定义模板被存放的类目目录，斜线分隔层级。每个层级名称最长1024个字符，由不能包含空白字符、不能包含斜线。
description.en: The category directory where the custom template is stored. Hierarchy levels are separated by slashes. Each level name can be up to 1024 characters long and cannot contain whitespace characters or slashes.

description.zh: 规则模板名称，数字、英文字母、汉字、半角全角标点符号组合，最长512个字符。
description.en: The name of the rule template. It can be a combination of digits, English letters, Chinese characters, and half-width or full-width punctuation marks. The maximum length is 512 characters.
The settings required for sample collection.

description.zh:
模板的可用范围：
- Tenant：全租户都可用
- Project：只在当前项目中可用
description.en:
The visibility scope of the template:
- Tenant: available to the entire tenant
- Project: available only in the current project

title.en: Create a data quality rule template

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用
descriptions.en: You must purchase DataWorks Basic Edition or above to use this feature.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public create-data-quality-rule-template --name Table_row_Count_Verification --project-id 12345 --visible-scope Project --directory-path /ods/order_data --sampling-config SettingConfig=SET_odps.sql.udf.timeout=600s_SET_odps.sql.python.version=cp27 Metric=Count MetricParameters=SQL_:_select_count_1_from_table --checking-config Type=Fixed ReferencedSamplesFilter=bizdate_:_-1_,_-7_,_-1m --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public CreateDataQualityRuleTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --DirectoryPath '/ods/order_data' --CheckingConfig '{"Type":"Fixed","ReferencedSamplesFilter":"bizdate_:_-1_,_-7_,_-1m"}' --ProjectId 12345 --VisibleScope Project --SamplingConfig '{"SettingConfig":"SET_odps.sql.udf.timeout=600s_SET_odps.sql.python.version=cp27","Metric":"Count","MetricParameters":"SQL_:_select_count_1_from_table"}' --Name Table_row_Count_Verification
